General Safety Features of Vaporisers

Agent specificity, prevents wrong agent being loaded into vaporiser

- Key indexed filling
- Pin indexed safety system connectors
- Colour coding of unit and agent containers

Single agent administration - Prevents multiple vaporisers being turned used simultaneously.

- Interlock mechanism
- Single cartridge slot (Aladdin system)

Tipping and overfilling protection, prevents liquid entering bypass or outflow 

- Long vaporisation chamber inflow
- Heavy construction
- Transport modes
- Side filling and overflow ports

Anti-pumping: Oscillating pressure with ventilatory cycle can alter & cause retrograde flow from the vaporiser chamber producing unpredictable variations in vapour delivered to patient

- Check valves and long vaporisation chamber inflow prevent entrainment of vaporiser gas in the inflow of the bypass channel

Agent depletion :

- Filling gauges
- Low pressure alarms (Tec 6)

Temperature fluctuations: ↓temperature →↓SVP →↓ Concentration of vapour given to patient

- Vaporiser has heat sink constructed of metals with high heat capacity & thermal conductivity function is that under steady-state conditions
- Temperature compensation: Bimetallic strip function to change fresh gas flow splitting ratio to maintain constant vapour concentration
